$comment: The set of package versions permitted to resolve into this repository's
dependency graph. Enforced by .pnpmfile.cjs, which throws during pnpm's
resolveDependency step - before any tarball is fetched - for anything absent.
Regenerate with scripts/generate-reviewed-set.mjs AFTER reviewing what is
entering (scripts/candidate.mjs) and writing a record. Regenerating to make a
failing install pass turns this gate into a rubber stamp.

bootstrap.name: inherited-tree-2026-08-24
bootstrap.honest_status: INHERITED, NOT AUDITED. These versions are the tree as it stood on 2026-08-24: advisory-clean per pnpm audit apart from the accepted elliptic finding, and build/type/test green. No human has read them. The value of this file is the ratchet on everything that arrives from now on, not retroactive certification of what is already here.

provenanceComment: Every permitted name@version has provenance. legacy:* entries predate per-version provenance; new admissions name their validated review record.
